steps.title: Genomics / Daily operations
steps.body:
Genomics is the study of an organism's entire set of DNA - its genome - including how all of its genes interact with each other and the environment to shape traits, health, and disease.

This is a fully interactive prototype, so please click around and check it out.

steps.title: Genomics / Methyl QC failures
steps.body: A methylation QC failure means a DNA test didn’t pass basic quality checks - usually because the DNA sample was damaged, the chemical prep didn't work properly, or the machine didn't read enough of it - so the results aren't reliable enough to use.

steps.title: Proteomics / Daily operations
steps.body: Proteomics is the large-scale study of the entire set of proteins produced by a cell, tissue, or organism - including their structures, functions, modifications, and interactions - to understand how biological systems operate in real time.

steps.title: Proteomics / Bead count failure
steps.body: A bead count failure happens when a lab test that uses microscopic beads to measure DNA or proteins doesn't detect enough of those beads to produce a trustworthy result.

steps.title: Proteomics / Longitudinal monitoring
steps.body: Longitudinal monitoring is the repeated tracking of the same biological samples over an extended period to observe changes, detect emerging patterns or disease progression, and evaluate outcomes over time.
